        function createCookie(name, value, expires) {
            document.cookie = name + "=" + value + "; max-age=" + expires + "; path=/";
        }
        function checkCookie(name) {
            const nameEQ = name + "=";
            const ca = document.cookie.split(';');
            for (let i = 0; i < ca.length; i = i + 1) {
                let c = ca[i];
                while (c.charAt(0) == ' ') c = c.substring(1, c.length);
                if (c.indexOf(nameEQ) == 0) return c.substring(nameEQ.length, c.length);
            }
            return null;
        }

    <h2 class="editorH2">Premier League Golden Boot Contenders</h2>

<p>Here are a handful of the contenders to win the Premier League Golden Boot:</p>

<h3 class="editorH3">Erling Haaland</h3>

<p>Erling Braut Haaland heads into the 2026/27 season as the clear favourite to win the Premier League Golden Boot once again. The Manchester City striker has won the award three times and needs one more to join record-holders Thierry Henry and Mo Salah on four. If Haaland stays fit for the majority of the campaign, he will be the player every other contender is trying to catch.</p>

<h3 class="editorH3">Alexander Isak</h3>

<p>Alexander Isak has established himself as one of the Premier League's most clinical forwards and will hope to show Liverpool fans this following a tough injury-hit 2025/26 season. Combining pace, intelligent movement, and composed finishing, Isak&nbsp;is capable of scoring against any opposition.</p>

<h3 class="editorH3">Igor Thiago</h3>

<p>Igor Thiago finds himself high up in the Premier League Top Scorer market following a superb 2025/26 season, during which he finished as the second highest scorer behind Haaland. The powerful forward&nbsp;thrives inside the penalty area and has a fantastic record from the penalty spot.</p>

<h3 class="editorH3">Joao Pedro</h3>

<p>Joao Pedro has developed into a versatile attacking player capable of scoring and creating goals in equal measure. Whether playing as a central striker or in a deeper attacking role, his technical ability and composure make him a dangerous threat. The Chelsea player scored 15 non-penalty goals in 2025/26 and looks well placed to have another stand-out campaign in front of goal.</p>

<h3 class="editorH3">Ollie Watkins</h3>

<p>Ollie Watkins remains one of the Premier League's most reliable goalscorers after several impressive seasons in front of goal. His work rate, intelligent runs, and ability to convert chances make him a constant threat, while his durability means he rarely misses extended periods through injury. Another productive campaign could see the Aston Villa striker firmly in contention for the Golden Boot.</p>

<h3 class="editorH3">Viktor Gyokeres</h3>

<p>Viktor Gyokeres enters his second Premier League season looking to build on a promising debut campaign, during which he scored 14 goals en route to helping Arsenal win the Premier League.</p>

<div class="text-block post-block link-underline ">
    <h2 class="editorH2">Who takes penalties in the Premier League?</h2>

<p>Typically, it is the strikers who take the penalties for most sides in the Premier League. Players like Erling Haaland, Cole Palmer, and Mohamed Salah are some of the league's most prolific penalty-takers, so it's always worth looking out for those names when picking your goalscorer bets before a given tie.</p>

<p>Looking at who the penalty takers are can sometimes help find some value in the Premier League top scorer odds and also any goalscorer markets in the match betting. If a player can add half a dozen goals to his tally from the penalty spot - just look at Cole Palmer at Chelsea in recent years -&nbsp;it can really enhance their chances of winning the Golden Boot.</p>
